title: Russian-Style Turkey Kebabs
description: A flavorful and hearty dish featuring marinated turkey kebabs served with a side of aromatic Russian-style potatoes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic.
Add the turkey, ham, and onion to the bowl. Toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated turkey and ham mixture onto the kebab skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the kebabs are cooking, boil diced potatoes in salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and toss with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs with the Russian-style potatoes and a side of your favorite sauce.
